entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while back. I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. It was for a cycling jersey.
Got it. I see the order here. Let me just ask, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered the wrong size. I tried it on once and it's just way too tight for me to cycle comfortably.
Okay, I understand completely. Sizing can be tricky. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered to you 56 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Right, it's been a couple of months. I'm hoping that's not a problem.

Not a problem at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the window. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'll be sending a prepaid shipping label to your email on file. You can use that to send the jersey back for a full refund.

That's great, I appreciate that. I was planning to order the correct size. Since I have to go through the trouble of shipping this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the new purchase? I'd like to do an exchange, essentially.
Let me see what I can do. While I can't process a direct exchange, I can offer you a 15% discount code for your next order as a courtesy. Would that work for you?
Yes, 15% is perfect. That more than covers the inconvenience. Thank you, David.
You're very welcome. I've added that code to the return confirmation email, which you should receive in the next 5-10 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
